entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For sales, press one. For technical support, press two. For returns or order inquiries, please stay on the line.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Service. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to return an item I purchased a little while ago.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see an order for one Aero Road Helmet, delivered on October 15th. To make sure I handle this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just a preference issue. To be honest, the box is still unopened. I got it as a gift, but the color isn't really my style.

I completely understand, getting the right color is important. Let me just take a quick look at our return policy for you... Okay, I've checked your order, and since it was delivered within the last 90 days, you are definitely eligible for a full refund.
That's great news. I was worried it might have been too long. Thank you for making that so simple.

Not a problem at all. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear. I can email you a prepaid return label right now. You just need to print it, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it at any post office.

Excellent. Now, I am planning to purchase a different helmet from your site once the refund comes through. Since I'm going through the process of a return and repurchase, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next order?

That's a fair question. I'm really glad to hear you're choosing VeloFit for your next helmet; your safety on the road is our highest priority. Unfortunately, my system doesn't allow me to issue credits or discounts on approved returns. However, I've just sent that return label to the email on file, so you can get the process started right away.
Alright, I thought I'd ask. No problem. Thanks for sending the label over so quickly.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Sarah.
It was my pleasure. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
